name: Maraudine Key Fragment
summary: The Maraudine Key Fragment is a piece held by Khan Hratha in Desolace. Both the Gelkis and Magram seek it after Hratha falls.

sections.title: A Piece of a Key
sections.body: Khan Hratha carries the Maraudine Key Fragment in the Valley of Spears. The Gelkis ask for it after he is slain, and the Magram make the same demand. Each clan seeks the fragment as part of its struggle against the Maraudine.

faq.q: Who has the Maraudine Key Fragment?
faq.answer: Khan Hratha holds the Maraudine Key Fragment in the Valley of Spears.
Uthek the Wise asks for the fragment in Gelkis Village, while Warug asks for it in Magram Village.

faq.q: Why do the Gelkis want it?
faq.answer: The Gelkis ask you to bring them the fragment after Khan Hratha is slain.

faq.q: Why do the Magram want it?
faq.answer: The Magram ask you to bring the fragment after Khan Hratha is slain.
